text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: HIGH error-rate alert for frontend-gateway (5xx surge) — multiple customers impacted :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: got it, joining. Seeing a spike in 5xx across edge-gateway routes. Triage channel: this thread.

ana: I see a jump in 5xx from 02:10 UTC, aligns with a deploy? any deploy hooks? :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: deploy finished for service/edge-proxy v2.14.3 at 02:07 UTC by kyle. No automated rollback triggered.

kyle: that deploy was just a config tweak to route weights + retry policy. rolling back now if needed.

jamal: can someone confirm 5xx class? 502 vs 504 vs 500?

maria: quick look at logs: majority are 502 from envoy upstream reset, some 504 timeouts for long-tailed requests. Sample: `502 "upstream reset"`

oncall-sre: initial hypothesis: route/cluster config change made in the deploy tightened circuit-breaker thresholds and enabled aggressive retry on 5xx which created retry amplification -> upstream saturation.

ana: copying relevant envoy stats (abridged):
```
cluster.edge-backend.upstream_rq_5xx: 1240
cluster.edge-backend.upstream_rq_4xx: 30
cluster.edge-backend.upstream_rq_retry: 980
listener.0.0.0.0:443.downstream_cx_total: 2400
```

kyle: yeah the change bumped per-host max pending requests from 100 -> 40 (trying to protect backend). That plus enabling retry-on-5xx for some routes could cause queue oscillation.

oncall-sre: mitigation plan: 1) disable retry-on-5xx globally at the gateway 2) relax circuit-breaker pending request threshold back to 100 3) route traffic away from affected hosts if saturation continues. Execute steps in order to avoid transient amplification.

jamal: I can flip the retry flag on the gateway config in prod. Doing it now.

deploy-bot: applying config change to edge-proxy: feature.retry_on_5xx = false; updating controlled rolling config.

kyle: rolling back the threshold change as a follow-up — I'm patching envoy cluster config to pending_requests: 100 now. Pushing config patch.

oncall-sre: while they roll, enable 429/5xx rate-limit fallback? probably unnecessary if retries stop.

alice-support: inbound CS reports show multiple customers seeing request failures to /v1/generate. Notified a few paying accounts. Would like an ETA for mitigation to update customers.

maria: after retry flag flip: upstream 5xx rate dropping in metrics. 5xx per minute: 140 -> 45 in last 60s.

ana: pending_requests metric returning to baseline. Looks promising.

jamal: retry_on_5xx disabled completed across all edge proxies at 02:18 UTC.

kyle: cluster pending_requests bumped back to 100 across the fleet at 02:20 UTC.

oncall-sre: monitoring. If errors continue after 02:25, we do a weighted routing shift off the smaller backend pool.

maria: error rate stabilized around baseline by 02:23 UTC. 5xx still sporadic but within SLO.

alice-support: replied to customers at 02:27 UTC — provided brief status and ETA: "mitigation applied, monitoring; we'll follow up with RCA."

oncall-sre: opening incident ticket for RCA and follow-up. Immediate actions: revert aggressive retries, restore pending_requests, communicate to customers.

ana: follow-ups for RCA: why was retry_on_5xx enabled in the first place? who approved the config change? Add a test to catch retry amplification in canaries.

kyle: that was my change — I was trying to reduce user-facing errors by retrying transient 5xx. I didn't fully test interplay with the lowered pending_requests. My fault. Will own the RCA and add canary test.

noncall-sre: handoff: I'm paged out at 02:40 UTC. ana, please take post-incident oncall until tomorrow.

ana: taking post-incident oncall. I'll collate logs, configs, and timeline.

maria: adding saved dashboards and key graphs to the ticket: envoy_upstream_5xx, pending_requests, retry_count, p99 latency.

jamal: quick note: consider defaulting to no-retry for 5xx and gating retries to specific idempotent paths only.

alice-support: will schedule follow-up status email to impacted customers for 03:00 UTC.

oncall-sre: incident closed for immediate mitigation at 02:30 UTC — monitoring continues. RCA owner: kyle. Postmortem ping at 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
